source: &1 Looks like you found the place.
&99 You're sure this is the one?
&2 I'm positive. Latha Sesame. Goes by 'Mandala' in the Trance.
target: &2 确定。拉塔·塞萨米。她在迷境里叫“曼荼罗”。

source: &5 There's a big gap in the records, and it's shaped exactly like her.
target: &5 记录里有一大块空白，正好把她的痕迹抹得干干净净。

source: &101 I thought you said he put a lot of effort into it?
target: &101 你不是说，他为这事费了不少心思吗？

source: &7 They've been hiding her activity, but weren't covering up their own work very well.
target: &7 他们把她的活动藏起来了，可自己的手脚却没掩饰好。
&102 要是他们真这么干了，那我——

source: &104 Won't be a problem for much longer.
target: &104 再过不久就不会是问题了。

source: &106 Don't worry, I know exactly what I'm doing.
target: &106 放心，我知道自己在做什么。

source: &107 After all, I've been planning this for years...
target: &107 毕竟，我为这件事筹划了好多年……
